observations: A stack of approximately 10 wooden pallets is shown outdoors on dry grass.
The pallets appear to be made of light-colored wood, consistent with reclaimed or used timber.
The top pallet in the stack is shown with its top surface removed, exposing the wooden slats underneath.
The stack is leaning against a concrete wall and a green tarp in the background.
Watermarks for 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EMMY BEST INTEGRATED' are present on all photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A video showing a load-bearing test with a known weight or a close-up of the pallet's construction joints.

risks.risk: Wood type and origin (e.g., pine vs. hardwood)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the wood grain and a label showing the species and origin.

risks.risk: Top surface condition and surface damage
risks.proof: Photos of the top surfaces of the pallets in the stack.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photos of the top surfaces of the pallets in the stack.
A video showing a load-bearing test or a close-up of the wood grain to confirm type.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
